relationships.subject: postganglionic sympathetic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that 82% of the neurons (32/39) expressed NaV1.7 mRNA.

relationships.subject: Nav1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: Selective NaV1.7 blockers substantially inhibited sympathetic nerve-mediated adrenergic contraction of blood vessels isolated from human and guinea pig tissue.

relationships.subject: ICA-121341
relationships.evidence_quote: ICA-121341, a compound capable of blocking NaV1.3 (McCormack et al., 2013), inhibited the CAP observed after NaV1.7 blockade.

key_findings: About 82% of guinea-pig stellate sympathetic neurons express Nav1.7 mRNA; Nav1.3 is the only other TTX-sensitive subtype, in about half.
Selective Nav1.7 blockers inhibit postganglionic action potentials and sympathetic adrenergic contractions in guinea-pig and human arteries, with residual activity blocked by a Nav1.3 inhibitor.
